title: Establish token contract and framework-interop attributes for button variants and icon states
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Multiple product teams are adding one-off overrides for button styles (icon-only sizing, loading spinner scale, disabled contrast) which bypasses our token system and causes inconsistent visuals, regressions in RTL and Safari focus behavior, and difficulty when customers apply custom themes. Goal: Define a stable token contract (CSS custom properties + token names) and a small set of data-* attributes to support framework interop (React/Vue/Svelte) so teams can alter behavior without breaking design tokens. Also fix a set of regressions discovered in last release: focus ring on Safari, icon vertical alignment in compact density, and spinner occlusion on dark themes.
acceptance_criteria: A token contract document exists mapping DS token names to CSS custom-properties and runtime keys
Buttons expose the documented data attributes (data-button-variant, data-button-loading, data-icon-only) and behavior is consistent across frameworks
Loading spinner scales correctly for small/medium/large buttons and is not clipped on dark themes
Disabled state meets contrast token minimums and pointer-events are disabled while still allowing focusable anchors when required
Regression fixes validated in Chrome, Firefox, Safari (macOS & iOS), and RTL locales
Unit and visual tests added to the design system repo and a vrt baseline accepted
steps_to_reproduce_regressions: 1) Open App Shell in Safari on macOS 14, tab to primary button — observe focus ring offset and unexpected blur
2) Add icon-only button in compact density in the playground — icon appears vertically misaligned by ~2px on Chrome and Safari
3) Toggle dark theme with loading state on a large button — spinner is partially occluded by inner padding/clipping
design_notes: Prefer CSS custom-properties on .rdw-button scope to allow runtime theme overrides without rebuilding bundles
Define semantic tokens (button.primary.bg, button.ghost.border) mapped to platform tokens; include examples for theme authors
Introduce data attributes instead of framework-specific props to minimize runtime surface area and enable non-JS fallbacks
Accessibility: disabled buttons should still expose aria-disabled="true" for assistive tech when they are non-interactive anchors
engineering_notes: Runtime: update button component to read data attributes and translate to internal classes for legacy frameworks
Spinner: replace absolute clipping with an inline svg whose viewBox scales using currentColor and a tokenized scale multiplier
Add small polyfill for :focus-visible differences across Safari (see PR #1142) and prefer focus ring via outline-offset token
Add unit tests for token fallback behavior when custom properties are not present (SSR case)
Ensure existing button stories preserve previous classnames for backwards compatibility for one release
